Hi everyone! I thought you all might enjoy this recipe for beef stew - it was always one of my favorites growing up, and probably one of the only reasons I look forward to the colder months! It's a nice hearty stew with a tomato base. Please note that while I have achieved better results browning the meat, you may simply add it raw instead - Here we go!

Ingredients

  • 2lbs. Stew Beef (lamb can also be used if you prefer, although its preparation may differ slightly)
  • 4 cans condensed tomato soup
  • 2 bags of frozen stew vegetables
  • 1-2 Bay Leaves
  • 1-2 Tbsp. Butter (for optional meat braising)
  • Pepper
  • Salt
  • Sugar
  • Water

If you have chosen to braise the meat in a skillet, combine the contents of your skillet, butter and all, into the crock pot with the tomato soup and stew vegetables. Stir in 1-2 soup cans full of water to achieve the desired consistency (I prefer a thicker stew, so I usually use about 1-and-a-half cans). Liberally sprinkle in pepper, a few tablespoons of salt, 2 or 3 pinches of sugar, and a bay leaf or two. It's ready! Store in the fridge overnight, or start cooking it right away! For best results, cook 6-8 hours on low. Stir and taste occasionally - you may choose to add more salt, pepper, or sugar to suit your taste. If the stew is too thin after cooking, remove the cover and continue to cook and occasionally stir until the desired consistency is achieved. Best served on a chilly post-football Sunday evening, over white rice, and/or with some nice hearty bread to dip!

For Veuwer:
On your veuwer image's page, look to the right. There should be a pair of text boxes. One labeled "Link" and the other "Direct Link". If you submit the Direct Link to Voat, you should get the expander.

For SLiMGUR:
On the image's page (example: https://slimgur.com/image/T0M) scroll down to where you see the words "About" and "Embed Codes". Click on "Embed Codes". The first text box is labeled "Image URL". If you submit this link, you should always get the expander.

In both cases, the link should end in something like ".png", ".gif", ".gifv" or ".jpg". If it ends in anything else, the expander won't be enabled. Example:
This https://veuwer.com/i/2saj will give you a link to a webpage and no expander. While this: https://veuwer.com/i/2saj.png links directly to the image and will give the expander.
